AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Digestive systems of animals? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Digestive systems of animals.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Digestive systems of animals.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Digestive systems of animals.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Digestive systems of animals.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Livestock Products? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Livestock Products.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Livestock Products.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Livestock Products.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Livestock Products.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Inorganic fertilisers? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Inorganic fertilisers.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Inorganic fertilisers.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Inorganic fertilisers.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Inorganic fertilisers.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Aquaculture.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Aquaculture.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Aquaculture.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Aquaculture.

5. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Ice melting to water

6. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

7. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Glucose and oxygen

8. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 37 °C

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water conservation.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Water conservation.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water conservation.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water conservation.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Structures in Animal production? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Structures in Animal production.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Structures in Animal production.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Structures in Animal production.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Structures in Animal production.

11. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A mixture of two liquids

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Production Structures? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Production Structures.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Production Structures.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Production Structures.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Production Structures.

13. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

14. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Producers
   D. Decomposers only

15. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

16. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. newton (N)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Structures in Animal production and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Aquaculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Rearing Selected Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Livestock Products and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Powered Tools and Equipment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Management of Agro- byproducts and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
